results.title: The Roast of Tom Brady
results.overview: Offensive lines. Full-contact comedy. Kevin Hart hosts this all-star roast of NFL legend Tom Brady.

results.title: Gentle Wife: Revenge of the Slut
results.overview: Joo-man starts an affair with the younger Jin-nyeo and drives out his wife, Soon-jeong. Soon-jeong, who was kicked out to an empty house, meets a robber, Do-sik. At first, she was bullied by Do-sik, but she turned it around and began abusing him instead. Do-sik suddenly falls in love with Soon-jeong, and the two eventually plot to kidnap Joo-man and Jin-nyeo.

results.title: I Live Where You Vacation, Al Límite del Paraíso Vol. III. Costa Norte
results.original_title: I Live Where You Vacation, Al Límite del Paraíso Vol. III. Costa Norte

results.title: The Paradise of Thorns
results.overview: When his partner Sek dies, Thongkam loses his property to his late love's eager family and must fight to reclaim the home they built together.

results.title: Blood Magick
results.overview: A witch with a foul mouth and a hangover is the only hope for a group of strangers when their town is invaded by the forces of Hell.

results.title: Caio
results.overview: The teenage aspiration for independence crashes like an aggressive wave of loneliness. Some drown. In a century where the normal has been transformed into hiding behind lenses, Caio does not learn how to express his feelings, which ends up costing him his life. Only then, the space to explore the boy's suffering appear. Marisol, Elena, and Artur cope with the loss of Caio in different ways. The Brazilian independent film, created by two teenagers, offers a profound reflection on the fragility of existence, the risks of isolation, the power of hope, and the importance of unbreakable bonds formed in moments of shared pain.

results.title: Neighboring Animals
results.overview: The title piece is a two-channel video centered on the mouth – as a tool to bite and chew, as an instrument of speech, and as a site of disgust and desire. It incorporates footage of animal dentistry, bite mark analysis, and a reliquary containing the tooth of Mary Magdalene. Projected alongside is a text collaging language from psychological studies on disgust, philosophical inquiries on human nature and animality, and poetry.

results.title: Near Miss
results.overview: Jim marries his first interested partner but after her departure, his friends push him into dating apps where he unexpectedly falls for the second person who showed interest.

results.title: Hain
results.overview: With its intriguing chess-like plot, Hain explores the scheming world of those in power who consider themselves "chosen" in Turkey and around the world. The seemingly unshakeable order of this powerful group is destroyed by female heroes, and the revenge-filled story is brought to the big screen with cinematic magic.

results.title: Tóxico
results.overview: Follows four youngsters who will commit vandalistic and vulnerable acts to try to survive, but these acts will bring unexpected consequences.

results.title: Manuscript
results.overview: The gaucho Martín Fierro stops in front of an isolated farmhouse, dismounts, and knocks on the door. After a few seconds, the owner answers. It is José Hernández, his writer. For an afternoon, character and author confront each other in a final encounter that will seal their destinies.

results.title: Obsession
results.overview: Liz, a young forensic scientist, and detective of the FBI is handed the Rosendale Ripper Case. While working the case, Liz is constantly reminded of her past. Will she solve the case, or will her obsession drive her to insanity?

results.title: L'avance
results.overview: After selling a painting depicting his late mother to a respected collector, Aliou must contend with the hidden costs of this exchange.

results.title: Para Hipólito
results.overview: Hipólito nostalgically recalls his childhood and youth in a land far removed from the one where he grew up. With a letter found among old photos, we are transported back to 1970, when he was 10 years old. A past set in a small village, marked by a longing to see the world. However, his father will not allow his only son to leave.

results.title: In the Footsteps of Bartók
results.overview: The dramatized documentary In the Footsteps of Bartók (Bartók Nyomában) follows Béla Bartók’s trip to Turkey in 1936, from Istanbul to Adana, during which it became clear that Turkish and Hungarian folk music have similarities that go back to our roots.

results.title: Believe in Christmas
results.overview: Two best friends travel to Christmasland, a place filled with hope and miracles.

results.title: Detective Conan vs. Kid the Phantom Thief
results.original_title: TVシリーズ特別編集版『名探偵コナン vs. 怪盗キッド』
results.overview: A special compilation movie bringing together the clashes between Detective Conan and Kaito Kid, high school student Kuroha Kaido discovers his late father's secret life as Phantom Thief Kid, inherits his costume and embarks on a mission to uncover the mysterious organization behind his father's murder.

results.title: Timelessness
results.overview: A knight wakes up from a long sleep in the forest. Time has stopped, nature is withering. He must remember who he was and what happened.

results.title: We Are Zombies
results.overview: In a city infested with the LIVING-IMPAIRED aka non-cannibal zombies - three slackers after easy money must fight small-time crooks and an evil megacorporation to save their kidnapped grandma.
